premises.scope: For U^T U=I_2, invertible symmetric 2x2 Lambda and independent cap-one originals, sup_t E|((U^TX)^T Lambda(U^TX)+b^TX)-t|^{-1/2} <=128 |det Lambda|^{-1/4}.
For one bank with residual energy rho and transverse Gram G, an ORIGINAL-coordinate partition S,Y,Z satisfies rho_S M(G_Y,G_Z)>=(2/81)rho det G.
Three genuinely independent scalar source-bank observables with density caps; triangular shears in the proved order; not a generic mixed-row receiver.
The newest Claude source does not prove generic hub-that-sees-P boundedness.

new_results.statement: In the positive-leakage near-coloop Parseval state, for Z=sqrt(c)H+T and transverse projection P, r_{Z,P}(z,p)<=c^{-1/2}p_P(p), hence ||p_{Z|P=p}||infinity<=c^{-1/2} a.e.; this is not used as independence.
For M=[[alpha,m^T],[m,N]], conditioning leaves and taking the physical-hub discriminant gives B_h^2-4A_hC_h=4c[(m.P)^2-alpha P^TNP+alpha s], exactly eliminating T; det(mm^T-alpha N)=alpha det M.

Applying account04/B10 to G=I and residual t gives rho_S>=2rho/81, M(G_Y,G_Z)>=2/81, lambda_min(G_Y+G_Z)>=2/81; conditioning X_S leaves longitudinal energy <=79rho/81 and aggregate fixed-hub triple determinant mass >7/288.
